scenarioA:
CT07 r2 — In review. Trace: OBJ1, BR1, BAC1. Engineering owns recovery; the selected HTTP supplier provides jobs, and operators reconcile unknown outcomes. Authority: supplier revision 7; its source link and acceptance record are not supplied.

Replace fresh-key retries with at most two repeats within 30 seconds, using the original tenant, key and identical payload, entirely within the supplier’s 24-hour guarantee. Concurrent repeats share that identity. Changed payloads must be rejected. This guarantees at most one effect within that scope, not eventual creation or identical responses. A timeout means unknown, not failure/no effect. Confirmed job evidence establishes creation; an absent eventually consistent lookup remains unknown.

After budget exhaustion or key expiry, prohibit automatic resubmission, including a fresh key. Expose the unknown state and request identity for Engineering-owned operator reconciliation. Do not resubmit until authoritative evidence establishes no effect; reconciliation completion depends on such evidence. The supplier’s repeated-response semantics and authoritative reconciliation evidence remain undocumented.

TC1 planned: lose the response after creation; repeat concurrently with unchanged identity; more than one job fails. TC2 planned: changed payload must be rejected. TC3 planned: absent lookup, exhausted budget or expiry must retain observable unknown and prevent unsafe submission.

EV1: supplied executed-pass for one sandbox success only; tested revisions unspecified. EV2–EV4: planned against CT07 r2/supplier revision 7; recovery conformance remains unverified. No acceptance or implementation.
scenarioB:
CT07 r2 — In review. Trace: OBJ1, BR1, BAC1. Engineering owns recovery with operators; the selected HTTP supplier provides jobs. Supplier revision 7 offers correlation only. Its source link and acceptance record are not supplied.

Reject the proposed timed-out POST retries: neither a fresh key nor reuse of the correlation key prevents duplicates. A timeout leaves the effect unknown. Issue no repeat creation request while that uncertainty remains, including concurrent repeats. Observable unknown plus operator reconciliation satisfies BAC1 without weakening BR1 or promising eventual creation.

Expose request identity and unknown state to operators. Engineering owns obtaining authoritative supplier evidence and reconciling any confirmed job. Lookup absence is inconclusive and cannot authorize resubmission. A new attempt requires definitive evidence that the earlier attempt produced no effect. The evidence source and reconciliation completion rule remain gaps for Engineering; the dependent recovery clause stays provisional. Do not reopen the selected HTTP transport.

TC1 planned: supplier creates a job but its response is lost; any automatic repeat fails. TC2 planned: lookup temporarily returns absent; state must remain observable unknown and reconciliation pending. TC3 planned: authoritative job evidence resolves the request to that job without creating another.

EV1: supplied executed-pass for one sandbox success only; tested revisions unspecified, no recovery proof. EV2–EV4: planned against CT07 r2/supplier revision 7; conformance unverified. No implementation or acceptance.
